# Method: move()

```ts
move(layer, newIndex): void;
```

Move a user-created layer to a new index in the stack.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| ------ | ------ | ------ |
| `layer` | [`TextmodeLayer`](../../TextmodeLayer.md) | Layer to move. |
| `newIndex` | `number` | Target index. |

## Returns

`void`
